verdict.rationale: RustDesk's own docs list Web as a supported platform, describe hosting the web client on your own server and domain, and say 1.5.0 adds WebRTC paths for direct access from the web client. That is a first-party browser client, so the viewer side needs nothing installed. The docs never explicitly say a web-client user can both view and control a session, and no community or hands-on report confirms the browser client works. missing for 10: explicit documentation of view and control from the web client, confirmation that no plugin or install is needed in the browser, independent or hands-on corroboration of the web client working.

support.subject: As a power user, someone can view or control a session from a plain browser with nothing installed

citations.quote: Host the web client on your server with your domain name to make remote access even easier.
Works on Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android, Web.
RustDesk 1.5.0 adds WebRTC connection paths, enables direct access from the web client
